abilities.name: Divine Purpose
abilities.description: Activate to instantly charge Yrel's next Basic Ability at no Mana cost. Divine Purpose's cooldown is reset when Yrel casts a Heroic Ability. Passive Yrel's Basic Abilities charge up over 1.5 seconds, increasing in effectiveness, but reducing Yrel's Movement Speed by 25%.; 8; trait

fields.notes: Activating Divine Purpose does not dismount. Yrel channels Abilities indefinitely until they are cast or interrupted. If Yrel is interrupted while channeling a Basic Ability, it goes on full cooldown without firing off.

abilities.name: Vindication
abilities.description: Unleash holy energy around Yrel, dealing 42 damage to nearby enemies and healing her for 96. Charging up this Ability increases its damage up to 140, and healing up to 320.

abilities.name: Righteous Hammer
abilities.description: Swing Yrel's hammer, dealing 38 damage to enemies in front of her and knocking them away. Charging up this Ability increases its knockback distance, and damage up to 125. Enemies hit at maximum charge are Stunned for 0.75 seconds.

fields.props: Area of Effect, Clamping, Knockback, Mobile channel (charge), Stun
fields.notes: 1) Swing search is done in three 60 degree areas rotating clockwise over 0.1875 seconds. Enemies can only be hit by the Ability once regardless.

abilities.name: Avenging Wrath
abilities.description: Leap to a location, dealing 225 damage to enemies in an area and Slowing them by 50% for 1 second. Charging up this Ability increases its range.

fields.type: Spell Damage, Crowd control / Movement: Launch
fields.props: Area of Effect, Clamping, Mobile channel (charge), Slow, Self-castable
fields.notes: Being Rooted prevents initiating the charge and interrupts the Ability if it is charging, putting it on full cooldown. Leap has a set duration regardless of distance.

abilities.name: Ardent Defender
abilities.description: Surround Yrel in a barrier for 3 seconds, absorbing all damage taken and healing her for 50% of the damage received.

fields.notes: Healing is calculated from final damage taken, after all modifications.

abilities.name: Sacred Ground
abilities.description: Yrel sanctifies the ground around her, gaining 50 Armor until she leaves the area.

fields.notes: Cooldown starts when the Ability is cast. Does not stack with itself or other positive Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

talents.name: Light of Karabor
talents.description: Increase Vindication's radius by 15%. Hitting an enemy Hero increases Vindication's healing by 45%. If more than one Hero is hit, the bonus is increased by 90%.
_raw_fields: Increase Vindication's radius by 15%. Hitting an enemy Hero increases Vindication's healing by 45%. If more than one Hero is hit, the bonus is increased by 90%.

talents.name: Dauntless
talents.description: Casting a Basic Ability grants Yrel 35 Physical Armor for 2.5 seconds.

fields.notes: Requires successfully casting a Basic Ability. Subsequent instances of Dauntless refresh the duration. Does not stack with itself. Does not stack with other Physical Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

_raw_fields: Casting a Basic Ability grants Yrel 35 Physical Armor for 2.5 seconds.

talents.name: Maraad's Insight
talents.description: After damaging an enemy Hero with a Basic Ability, Yrel's next Basic Attack heals her for 160.

fields.notes: Maraad's Insight does not stack nor generate charges. A Basic Attack at full Health does not consume the healing.

_raw_fields: After damaging an enemy Hero with a Basic Ability, Yrel's next Basic Attack heals her for 160.

talents.name: Aegis of Light
talents.description: Upon landing, Avenging Wrath grants other nearby allied Heroes 40 Armor for 5 seconds.

fields.notes: Does not stack with other positive Armor effects. Other defensive damge modifiers may stack.

_raw_fields: Upon landing, Avenging Wrath grants other nearby allied Heroes 40 Armor for 5 seconds.

talents.name: Gift of the Naaru
talents.description: Divine Purpose heals the lowest Health nearby allied Hero other than Yrel for 275.
_raw_fields: Divine Purpose heals the lowest Health nearby allied Hero other than Yrel for 275.

talents.name: Hand of Freedom
talents.description: cooldown 30 active Grant an allied Hero 30% Movement Speed for 3 seconds and remove all Slows and Roots from them.
_raw_fields: cooldown 30 active Grant an allied Hero 30% Movement Speed for 3 seconds and remove all Slows and Roots from them.

talents.name: Righteous Momentum
talents.description: Gain 5% Movement Speed. Yrel is no longer Slowed while channeling Righteous Hammer, and instead this bonus is quadrupled.
_raw_fields: Gain 5% Movement Speed. Yrel is no longer Slowed while channeling Righteous Hammer, and instead this bonus is quadrupled.

talents.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Avenging Wrath at maximum charge deals 25% more damage and reduces its cooldown to 1 second.

fields.notes: Damage reduction stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers affecting the target Heroes' damage output.

talents.name: Repentance
talents.description: Increase Avenging Wrath's Slow by 25% and duration by 0.75 seconds.

talents.name: Velen's Chosen
talents.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with a Basic Ability at maximum charge grants 10% Spell Power for 10 seconds, up to 30%.

fields.type: Offensive damage modifier, Healing dealt modifier
fields.notes: Limited to 1 stack per cast. Subsequent instances of Velen's Chosen refresh the duration. Stacks additively with itself and other sources of Spell Power. Stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers or healing dealt modifiers that can affect Yrel's damage or healing output respectively.

talents.name: Templar's Verdict
talents.description: Righteous Hammer reduces the Armor of enemy Heroes hit by 15 for 4 seconds and deals bonus damage equal to 6% of their maximum Health.

fields.notes: Bonus damage is dealt in a separate instance. Does not stack with other negative Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

talents.name: Divine Favor
talents.description: Casting a Basic Ability reduces the cooldown of Divine Purpose by 2.5 seconds.
_raw_fields: Casting a Basic Ability reduces the cooldown of Divine Purpose by 2.5 seconds.

talents.name: Holy Wrath
talents.description: After casting a Basic Ability, Yrel's next Basic Attack splashes for 35% increased damage around the target.

fields.notes: Increases Yrel's next Basic Attack's damage by the given amount, which then splashes to nearby enemies for 100% of the (increased) damage. Requires successfully casting a Basic Ability. Holy Wrath does not stack with itself. Damage bonus stacks with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Yrel's Basic Attack damage.

_raw_fields: After casting a Basic Ability, Yrel's next Basic Attack splashes for 35% increased damage around the target.

talents.name: Word of Glory
talents.description: Increase the amount that Yrel heals from damage received from 50% to 75%. Ardent Defender heals nearby allied Heroes for 100% of the healing received by Yrel.
_raw_fields: Increase the amount that Yrel heals from damage received from 50% to 75%. Ardent Defender heals nearby allied Heroes for 100% of the healing received by Yrel.

talents.description: Cooldown 80 Active After 1 second, Yrel becomes Invulnerable and casts Hearthstone. Cannot be canceled.

fields.notes: Interrupting the Ability during its windup puts it on a 10 second cooldown.
